system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

data_description.dataset_name: Copernicus Global Land Cover Layers: CGLS-LC100 Collection 3

spatial_coverage.coverage: Global land surface coverage at 100m resolution providing discrete land cover classifications and continuous field layers for the period 2015-2019, derived from PROBA-V satellite data.

data_description.records: ImageCollection with yearly global land cover from 2015-2019

discrete_classification.description: Discrete land cover classification (0=No data, 20=Shrubs, 30=Herbaceous vegetation, 40=Cultivated, 50=Urban, 60=Bare, 70=Snow and ice, 80=Water bodies, 90=Herbaceous wetland, 100=Moss and lichen, 111-126=Forest types)

forest_type.description: Forest type layer with detailed forest classifications

tree-coverfraction.description: Percentage of tree cover within pixel (0-100%)

crops-coverfraction.description: Percentage of cropland cover within pixel (0-100%)

urban_coverfraction.description: Percentage of urban/built-up cover within pixel (0-100%)

raster_content.thematic_group: Global Land Use and Land Cover

band_semantics.discrete_classification: Primary discrete land cover classification layer
band_semantics.tree-coverfraction: Continuous tree cover fraction for sub-pixel analysis
band_semantics.crops-coverfraction: Continuous cropland fraction for agricultural monitoring

data_description.important_note: Copernicus Global Land Cover provides both discrete classifications and continuous cover fraction layers, enabling both categorical and quantitative land cover analysis. The 100m resolution bridges the gap between coarse MODIS (500m) and fine Sentinel-based products (10m).
analytical_capabilities: Discrete land cover classification with 23 classes including detailed forest types
Sub-pixel land cover fraction analysis using continuous cover layers
Agricultural land monitoring using crops-coverfraction layer
Forest cover assessment with both discrete and continuous metrics
Mixed-pixel composition analysis combining multiple fraction layers
Land cover validation using fraction layers as ground truth proxy

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Discrete classification: categorical class codes (0-200); Cover fraction layers: percentage (0-100%).
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use 'discrete_classification' for categorical analysis; use cover fraction bands (e.g., 'tree-coverfraction', 'crops-coverfraction') for continuous sub-pixel assessment.

data_description.data_source: Copernicus Global Land Service via Google Earth Engine
